p1_year.compiled_sql:
SELECT
  metric_time__year
  , SUM(premium_completed_revenue) AS premium_completed_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('year', order_date) AS metric_time__year
    , status AS sales__status
    , unit_price AS sales__unit_price
    , revenue AS premium_completed_revenue
  FROM "warehouse"."gold"."fact_sales" sales_src_10000
) subq_2
WHERE sales__status = 'completed' AND sales__unit_price >= 100
GROUP BY
  metric_time__year

p2_year.compiled_sql:
SELECT
  metric_time__year
  , SUM(french_market_revenue) AS french_market_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('year', sales_src_10000.order_date) AS metric_time__year
    , sales_src_10000.status AS sales__status
    , customers_src_10000.country AS customer__country
    , sales_src_10000.revenue AS french_market_revenue
  FROM "warehouse"."gold"."fact_sales" sales_src_10000
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "warehouse"."gold"."dim_customers" customers_src_10000
  ON
    sales_src_10000.customer_id = customers_src_10000.customer_id
) subq_5
WHERE sales__status = 'completed' AND customer__country = 'France'
GROUP BY
  metric_time__year

metrics_yaml:
metrics:
  # --- Simple metrics: one measure, surfaced as a business number -------
  - name: revenue
    description: "Total sales revenue."
    label: "Revenue"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue

  - name: cost
    description: "Total cost of goods sold."
    label: "Cost"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: cost

  - name: gross_profit
    description: "Revenue minus cost."
    label: "Gross profit"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: gross_profit

  - name: quantity_sold
    description: "Total units sold."
    label: "Quantity sold"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: quantity_sold

  - name: discount
    description: "Total discount granted."
    label: "Discount"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: discount

  - name: orders
    description: "Number of distinct orders."
    label: "Orders"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: order_count

  - name: active_customers
    description: "Distinct customers who placed at least one order."
    label: "Active customers"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: customer_count

  # --- Filtered simple metrics -----------------------------------------
  - name: completed_revenue
    description: "Revenue from completed orders only."
    label: "Completed revenue"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue
    filter: "{{ Dimension('sales__status') }} = 'completed'"

  - name: returned_orders
    description: "Orders that were returned."
    label: "Returned orders"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: order_count
    filter: "{{ Dimension('sales__status') }} = 'returned'"

  # --- Ratio metrics ----------------------------------------------------
  - name: gross_margin_rate
    description: "Gross profit divided by revenue."
    label: "Gross margin rate"
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: gross_profit
      denominator: revenue

  - name: average_order_value
    description: "Revenue per order (AOV)."
    label: "Average order value"
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: revenue
      denominator: orders

  # --- Derived metric: a formula over other metrics ---------------------
  - name: return_rate
    description: "Share of orders that were returned, in percent."
    label: "Return rate (%)"
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: "returned_orders / nullif(orders, 0) * 100"
      metrics:
        - name: returned_orders
        - name: orders

  # --- Customer loyalty: repeat-purchase behaviour ----------------------
  - name: purchasing_customers
    description: "Customers who have placed at least one order (loyalty denominator)."
    label: "Purchasing customers"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: purchasing_customer_count

  - name: repeat_customers
    description: "Customers who ordered on more than one occasion."
    label: "Repeat customers"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: purchasing_customer_count
    filter: "{{ Dimension('customer__is_repeat_customer') }} = true"

  - name: repeat_customer_rate
    description: "Share of purchasing customers who ordered more than once (0-1)."
    label: "Repeat customer rate"
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: repeat_customers
      denominator: purchasing_customers

  - name: premium_completed_revenue
    description: "Completed revenue on lines with unit price at least 100."
    label: "Premium completed revenue"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue
    filter: "{{ Dimension('sales__status') }} = 'completed' AND {{ Dimension('sales__unit_price') }} >= 100"

  - name: french_market_revenue
    description: "Completed revenue of customers in France."
    label: "French market revenue"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue
    filter: "{{ Dimension('sales__status') }} = 'completed' AND {{ Dimension('customer__country') }} = 'France'"
